description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BookingDetails" name="Route, personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackRequest" name="Feedback request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_TravelBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelBooking"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SearchRequest" name="Search request" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Search"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Receive_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Ticket" name="Ticket" messageRef="Msg_Ticket" sourceRef="Send_Ticket" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder" messageRef="Msg_Reminder" sourceRef="Send_Reminders" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FeedbackRequest" name="Feedback request" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackRequest" sourceRef="Send_FeedbackRequest" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Receive_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:messageStartEvent id="Start_Search" name="Customer searches for flight, train or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:messageStartEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowOptions" name="Provide route, date and time options"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_BookingDetails" name="Receive selected route, personal information and payment details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TicketSplit" name="Split ticket and inventory work"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Ticket" name="Send ticket to customer via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TicketJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Reminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JourneyCompleted" name="Customer completes journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Feedback or post-travel services offered?" default="Flow_EndDirect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_FeedbackRequest" name="Send feedback request or post-travel service offer" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Feedback" name="Receive customer feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JourneyConcluded" name="Process concluded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackReceived" name="Feedback received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Search" targetRef="Task_ShowOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ShowOptions" targetRef="Receive_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Receive_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_TicketSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketSplit" targetRef="Send_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Send_Ticket" targetRef="Gateway_TicketJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_TicketJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketJoin" targetRef="Send_Reminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Send_Reminders" targetRef="Event_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackYes" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Send_FeedbackRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${feedbackOrServicesOffered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndDirect" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="End_JourneyConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Send_FeedbackRequest" targetRef="Receive_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Receive_Feedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
